properties.evidence: The pruning decision dropped req:friction-has-a-severity-bar and req:friction-has-a-baseline as 'backlog hygiene dressed as product requirements — the answer to unconverted friction reports is to act on them, not to model them'. This idea proposes modelling field evidence as a prioritisation input: the same move at a different altitude. Confidence 0.6 rather than 1.0 because the two are arguably about different subjects — the dropped pair measured REFLOW2'S OWN usability, this is about any user's design reading its own test reports. Recorded as opposing so the tension is visible and nobody re-litigates the prune by accident.
